existing_multilingualProvision: Not established from the sources consulted — a language-appropriate LITMUS sentence repetition instrument exists for this system (see assessments above), but whether any service, clinical guideline or funder requires, supports or reimburses assessment in all of a child's languages was not determined. existing_terminology:

The Education Act 2001 fixes only learning difficulty and names no speech or language category
The 2004 SEN Regulations likewise name only learning difficulty, no speech or language category
existing_identificationCriteria:
A list of support needs, not a diagnosis: understanding language and talking
On referral the service gives assessment, review and advice or an intervention programme
existing_referralPathway:
Referrals taken from parents or carers, GP, health visitor, school nurse, teachers
The team is based at the Community Health Centre in Douglas
Children are referred on for off-island assessment at specialist clinics
existing_serviceModel:
Children are seen from birth to 18 in clinic, home, nursery and school

existing_legalEntitlement:
Education Act 2001 with the Special Educational Needs Regulations 2004 approved by Tynwald
The Department must arrange the provision its report specifies for the child
Where provision is at another school the Department pays the whole of the fees
A parent may appeal to a committee of two or more people the Department appoints
existing_funding:
DHSC must lay an annual Mandate to Manx Care before Tynwald ahead of the financial year

existing_workforce:
The service page says it currently has 10 therapists and 1 assistant, with no date given

existing_outcomesEvidence: Not established from the sources consulted for this entry — gov.im and desc.gov.im both answer a plain GET with a short challenge stub rather than a document, so the Department of Education, Sport and Culture’s plans and the government’s education open data pages could not be read from here. This is a register that could not be reached, not a place where nothing is reported. If you work in this system, this is exactly the field to fill in.
